notes.title: New 2D mode is online
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864392/a3b77fb2f94941cffa130a8c238d8cf7fb2210c5.png[/img]
Dear players,
We are very excited to announce that this game update is now officially online! In order to allow every player to enjoy a richer, more interesting and smoother gaming experience, we have invested a lot of effort in this update. Not only has a new 2D billiards mode been launched, but also the game has been fully optimized and improved. The following are the details of this update. Come and see what surprises are waiting for you!
1. New 2D billiards mode is online
In order to allow players to experience more diversified game fun, we have grandly launched a new 2D billiards mode! This mode has been carefully designed to bring the ultimate battle experience to billiards enthusiasts. Specific features include:
Real physics engine: We have upgraded the game's physics system. The angle, strength and rebound effect of each shot have been accurately calculated to restore the real billiards experience.
Personalized choice: A variety of exquisite billiard table styles (such as classic wood grain, modern metal style) and cue skins (including limited edition designs) have been added, allowing you to create your own unique style according to your preferences.
2. Bug fixes and performance optimization
We have listened carefully to the feedback from players and have made comprehensive fixes and optimizations to the existing problems in the game to ensure that you can focus on enjoying the game instead of being bothered by technical problems.
3. More improvements and new content
In addition to new modes and problem fixes, we have also added some thoughtful small updates to the game to make every time you play it fresh:
Our commitment
Every content of this update is inseparable from the support and suggestions of all players. Whether it is the development of new features or the repair of problems, it is our best response to your love for this game. We hope that through this update, you will feel our intentions and look forward to you finding more fun in the game.
Experience the new 2D billiards mode and brand new game content! I wish you have fun in the game and improve your skills.

notes.title: You can now play in full screen
notes.content: Press alt+enter to enter the full screen game

notes.title: Addition of Chinese Language Support!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are very happy to announce that our game now has Chinese language support! From now on, you can select Chinese as your language option in the game and enjoy a smoother and more convenient gaming experience.

We know that many players are eager to experience the game in a language they are familiar with and better understand the game content. Therefore, we translated the game into Chinese to provide a better gaming experience for the majority of Chinese players.

We hope that by adding Chinese language support, we can further close the connection with Chinese players and create a more friendly and immersive gaming environment for you.

Whether you are a new player or an old player, you can select the Chinese language in the game settings. We encourage you to try switching to Chinese and explore the wonderful world of the game with us.

If you are using the Chinese language, there may still be some English left because the translation has not been fully completed.

Thank you for your continued support and love for our games! We will continue to work hard to provide you with more exciting game content and experiences.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Gathering Player Feedback and Suggestions!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We would like to express our gratitude for your continued support and enthusiastic participation in our game! In our pursuit to enhance the gaming experience and meet players' needs, we sincerely invite your feedback and suggestions. We are eager to hear your thoughts on what you enjoy about the game and your ideas for improvements and new content.

We are particularly interested in your opinions on the following aspects:

New Content Ideas: What kind of new content would you like to see in the game? Is it new levels, quests, characters, storylines, or any other creative ideas? Please share your thoughts and expectations with us.
Game Improvement Suggestions: Do you have any suggestions for improving the game? This could include enhancing controls, optimizing graphics, balancing game difficulty, or improving social features, among others. We value your input and strive to make the game better based on your feedback.
Community Interaction: Do you have any suggestions regarding community interaction? For example, increasing player communication channels, organizing events, or establishing player teams. We aim to create a vibrant and friendly community environment.
Please send your opinions and suggestions to our official email or leave a message in the game community. We will carefully read each feedback and consider your ideas as we continue to work towards providing an even better gaming experience.

Once again, we sincerely appreciate your support and passion for our game! We look forward to hearing your voice and collaborating with you to create a more exciting gaming world.

Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience!

The Game Developer
